title: Yara and the Cellar
author: Oscar Lockridge
blurb: Juniper Pemberton, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
